COMM 79073 - (was ACOM 7390) Introduction to Applied Communication Studies

Three credit hours.

Was ACOM 7390. Applied communication theories, terminology, program writing, presentation responsibilities; emphasis on research skills necessary for the field.

Prerequisites: Program admission or instructor consent. (Prerequisite course for entering students with fewer than 18 undergraduate speech hours; does not count toward degree requirements.)
